title: Police Officer Helps Stranded Family & Surprises Children with a Gift
description:
In South Bend, IN, Officer Howard was working 3rd Shift and received a call out to an area for a welfare check for a young lady with small children. He discovered they were stranded. So he decided to help them out and show up with a surprise for the children.

Well done, Officer Howard from the South Bend Police Department!
